chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Nereid's Ascension, killing both small enemies and dealing 16 damage to Leaf Slime (M), then All Streams Flow to the Sea on Leaf Slime (M) for 9 more damage.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Nereid's Ascension followed by Coral Guard, trading 9 damage on Leaf Slime (M) for 5 Block.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 5 Block from Coral Guard and the summon and Charge gain from Bake-Kurage in exchange for maximizing immediate damage.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If the surviving Leaf Slime (M) had telegraphed a meaningful attack instead of Status cards, I would have been more likely to play Coral Guard after Nereid's Ascension.
